command:
set -eu
git fetch origin main
git switch main
git merge --ff-only origin/main
HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo REPO_HEAD=$HEAD
[ "$HEAD" = "53c56fa54e92a713e555979f2d1778dc44dfaf98" ] || { echo EXACT_HEAD_GATE=FAIL; exit 21; }
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" || { git status --short; echo CLEAN_BASE_GATE=FAIL; exit 22; }
echo EXACT_HEAD_GATE=PASS
export JAVA_HOME=/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/temurin-21.jdk/Contents/Home
export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
java -version
./gradlew --no-daemon qualityCheck
./gradlew --no-daemon :app:assembleDebug
git diff --check
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" || { git status --short; echo FINAL_WORKTREE_GATE=FAIL; exit 23; }
echo QUALITY_GATE=PASS
echo APK_GATE=PASS
echo DIFF_CHECK=PASS
echo FINAL_WORKTREE_GATE=PASS
echo PHASE2_FINAL_BUILD_GATE=PASS
